$comment: The packs this repository generates components for. Each is read from git at the pinned commit `ref` (a full SHA, never a branch), from the sibling checkout `checkout` when it holds that commit, else by a shallow fetch of `repository`. Adding a pack is a new entry here; moving a pack forward is a new `ref`. `minIcons` is the floor the count guard enforces, set a little under the measured count. `licence` is the artwork's SPDX expression; attribution files are found by convention, read at `ref`: the pack's ATTRIBUTION.md and every file under resources/assets/svg/licenses/, copied to dist/<flavour>/<pack>/; an optional `attribution` list overrides that for a pack that needs it, and an entry that names no file fails the build. `exclude` lists source SVGs the policy rejects, each with its reason; an entry that stops being rejected fails the build. ichava/icon-sets-bundled is not here: it is private, proprietary and for internal and client use only, so a public package cannot ship it. ichava/icon-sets-metronic is private and never shown publicly.

packs.$comment: Twemoji only. The pack's two OpenMoji sets are deprecated there and moved to ichava/icon-sets-openmoji, which the openmoji entry generates; carrying them here too would ship 7,132 icons twice.
